description: Searches identity providers with the specified criteria and pagination.

applicationId.description: The application Id to search for identity providers.

name.description: The name of the identity provider to search for. Supports wildcard search using *.

numberOfResults.description: The number of results to return. Defaults to 25.

orderBy.description: The field to order the results by. Supported values: enabled, id, insertInstant, name, type.

startRow.description: The offset into the total results. Defaults to 0.

tenantId.description: The tenant Id to restrict the results to.

type.description: The type of identity provider to search for.

name: searchIdentityProvidersByParametersWithId
